methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
ADMARES is a seed-stage housing and construction technology company founded by Mikael Hedberg that has raised $1.78M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a private comp set of five peers in the construction tech space—BotBuilt, Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, and Hedral—given the absence of direct public comparables in this frontier subsector.

Stage-progression analysis, the applicable triangulation method, uses the $1.78M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in this market. This yields an implied valuation of $4.45M. The method assumes ADMARES will achieve comparable milestones to peer companies at similar progression stages.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.78M (low) to $5.12M (high), with a median of $4.45M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method rather than multiple triangulated approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the five-company private comp set, founder execution track record relative to peers, and product-market fit validation. A fuller valuation would benefit from revenue data or customer traction metrics if available, as well as expansion of the private comp universe to strengthen the stage-progression baseline.
